page_title: AST 3-2 EVE | Aston Villa v Everton 14/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+6' Dwight McNeil (Everton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Emiliano Martinez, who smothers the ball.
90+5' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) makes a good run to latch onto the free kick from Ian Maatsen, but pushes his close-range header well past the right post.
90+4' Ashley Young (Everton) brings his opponent down. Craig Pawson has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Aston Villa will take a free kick.
90+2' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
90+1' Jaden Philogene (Aston Villa) jumps into a tackle and Craig Pawson signals a foul. Everton win a free kick.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' The substitution has been made. Jaden Philogene (Aston Villa) has replaced John McGinn.
89' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.

89' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
88' The referee is firm and issues Jake O'Brien (Everton) a deserved yellow card.
86' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) smacks a great volley at goal from inside the box, but sends the effort just inches over the bar.
85' Referee Craig Pawson has finally had enough of Unai Emery and brandishes a yellow card at him!
84' Substitution. Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) replaces Ollie Watkins.
81' Here is a change. Iliman Ndiaye is going off and Sean Dyche gives the last tactical orders to Jesper Lindstrom (Everton).
81' Substitution. Beto (Everton) in, Tim Iroegbunam out.

81' Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his shot flies just over the crossbar. This should be a big warning for the defence.
81' There's an opportunity for Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
80' John McGinn (Aston Villa) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jordan Pickford intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Aston Villa.
79' The booking goes to Ashley Young (Everton).
79' What a chance that is! Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the crossbar!

76' 3 - 2 What a beautiful moment! Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top left corner. Jordan Pickford just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 3:2.
74' Dwight McNeil (Everton) tries to find Dominic Calvert-Lewin, but he puts too much power on the pass.
73' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) picks up an injury.
72' CHANCE! Ian Maatsen finds Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the left post!

71' Michael Keane (Everton) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the roof of the net. Emiliano Martinez displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
69' Unai Emery decides to make a substitution. Lucas Digne will be replaced by Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa).
69' The substitution is prepared. Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jacob Ramsey.
69' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) will deliver the corner kick.
68' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick.
67' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
65' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
64' Sean Dyche prepares a substitution. Idrissa Gueye is replaced by Orel Mangala (Everton).
64' Substitution. Jake O'Brien (Everton) on for Jack Harrison.
63' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Ollie Watkins.
61' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
61' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play and Aston Villa manage to earn a corner.
58' 2 - 2 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 2:2.
54' Dwight McNeil (Everton) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
54' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Good work from Everton as they win a corner.
51' John McGinn (Aston Villa) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.

50' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Jordan Pickford is alert and denies him with a nice save. Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the left side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.

47' Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) unnecessarily kicks the ball off the pitch. Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
46' Unai Emery has made a change at the break. Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) has come on in place of Amadou Onana.
46' The whistle blows and Craig Pawson starts the second half.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Craig Pawson blows his whistle after Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
45+5' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is penalised for holding. Craig Pawson signals a set piece.
45+2' Flag goes up against Dwight McNeil (Everton) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
45+1' Dwight McNeil (Everton) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
45+1' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
45' We will have 7 min. of added time.
45' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) swings it in and Morgan Rogers gets on the end of it, but Jordan Pickford shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
42' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat.
40' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
40' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is ready on the edge of the six-yard box and duly receives the cross, but his header fizzes just wide of the left post.
38' The game is interrupted now, Jordan Pickford (Everton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
36' 1 - 2 Lucas Digne launches a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) rises high to head the ball into the right side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. 1:2.

31' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom right corner. Jordan Pickford has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
30' He should have scored! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
30' 4:2 – the total goal attempt statistics. The number of shots on goal at present is 1:2.
29' No offside! Referee Craig Pawson points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Everton players.
28' Wait! Referee Craig Pawson has indicated he is going to review the Everton goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

27' 0 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Dwight McNeil flights the free kick into the box, where Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) peels off his marker and heads straight into the left side of the net from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 0:2.
26' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) leaves the pitch to be replaced by James Garner.
25' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
24' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
21' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
20' John McGinn (Aston Villa) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
19' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) for his blatant foul.
18' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) is able to continue to play.
17' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
16' 0 - 1 GOAL! Dwight McNeil (Everton) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 0:1.
15' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) picks up a yellow card.
12' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) connects with a loose ball in the box, but sends his first-time shot miles past the right post.
12' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) attempts to find Jacob Ramsey with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
10' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) receives a pass then lets rip from long range low towards the middle of the goal, but Jordan Pickford watches it all the way and makes an easy save.
9' Aston Villa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

9' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) rose high to meet a perfectly taken corner kick and attempted to steer a fine header from inside the box towards the left side of the goal. Nobody knows what would have happened if one of the defending players hadn’t pulled off a brilliant intervention to block the effort.
9' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

8' A pass lands at the feet of John McGinn (Aston Villa) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Aston Villa are going to take it.
6' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

5' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Aston Villa.
4' John McGinn receives a sweet cross inside the box from Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
1' Foul! Idrissa Gueye (Everton) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Aston Villa will have the kick-off.
Craig Pawson is the one to supervise the game today.
